facts.text: Serve the mains when the misfit team finally sits down together.
facts.why: The team never sits down to a meal together in the plot or transcript; the food moment is John Walker asking 'Anybody hungry?' and offering cactus berries on the way home.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when John Walker asks 'Anybody hungry?'

facts.text: Bob, eat. Nobody here is okay. We're all hungry.
facts.why: A note in Yelena's voice, not a quote. It fits the film: she talks Bob through feeling hollow and the team ends up hugging him. Keep it without quote marks. It is not printed on the single face.

facts.text: Alexei's way, jam stirred in, no arguing.
facts.why: Nothing in the transcript or plot shows Alexei making tea or stirring in jam, so the claim is unproven.
The film has Valentina send her operatives to the O.X.E. vault to kill each other, not on 'stolen jobs'.

vibe.verdict: Vault mess hall tray suits the film and the cactus berry, Alexei and hug jokes all print, with a stray double full stop on the stroganoff.
